# 📊 Supl Plot : bar chart orders 1

```{r}
b_taxonomy_df <- taxonomy_df |>
  #all Nan in all coulmns need to be replaces with a real NA for this
  dplyr::mutate(
    dplyr::across(
      .cols = c("species","genus","family", "order"),
      .fns = ~ dplyr::na_if(., "Nan")
    )
  ) |>
  # species name with sp. or similar need to be treated as NA
  dplyr::mutate(
    dplyr::across(
      .cols = c("species","genus","family"),
      .fns = ~ dplyr::case_when(
        stringr::str_detect(., regex("\\bsp\\b|\\bsp\\.\\b|\\bcf\\b|\\bcf\\.\\b|\\bspp\\b|\\bspp\\.\\b", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ NA_character_,
        TRUE ~ .
      )
    )
  ) |>
  # dplyr::mutate(
  #   res_rank = dplyr::case_when(
  #     same_species == "yes"                          ~ "species",
  #     same_species != "yes" & same_genus  == "yes"   ~ "genus",
  #     same_genus  != "yes" & same_family == "yes"    ~ "family",
  #     TRUE                                           ~ "higher_or_none"
  #   ),
  
  # use same threshold instead of using same_species, same_genus, same_family columns
  # Species: 99, Genus: 97, Family: 90, Order: 85 fill information above with blanks when perc_id is below the threshold
  
  dplyr::mutate(
    res_rank = dplyr::case_when(
      perc_id >= 99 ~ "species",
      perc_id >= 97 & perc_id < 99 ~ "genus",
      perc_id >= 90 & perc_id < 97 ~ "family",
      TRUE ~ "higher_or_none"),
     res_rank = factor(res_rank, levels = c("species","genus","family","higher_or_none"))
   ) |> 
  #mutate zotu_id to lower for the entries from Zotus1111 to zotus1111
  dplyr::mutate(
    zotu_id = stringr::str_to_lower(zotu_id)
  )

#join meta_oahu and zotu_df to make sure only oahu zOTUs are included
#first pivot longer zotu_df and then then join zotus

taxonomy_oahu <- zotu_df |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = dplyr::starts_with("zotu"),
    names_to = "zotu_id",
    values_to = "abundance"
  ) |>
  dplyr::inner_join(meta_oahu, by = "sample_id") |> 
  dplyr::select(sample_id, zotu_id, abundance) |> 
  dplyr::inner_join(b_taxonomy_df, by = "zotu_id") |> 
  dplyr::select(-sample_id, -sample_id, -abundance) |> 
  dplyr::distinct()



# Panel A1
figA1 <- taxonomy_oahu |>
  dplyr::count(res_rank) |>
  dplyr::mutate(prop = n / sum(n)) |>
  ggplot2::ggplot(ggplot2::aes(x = res_rank, y = prop)) +
  ggplot2::geom_col() +
  ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "Best BLAST consensus rank", y = "Proportion of zOTUs")

# Panel A2
figA2 <- taxonomy_oahu |>
  ggplot2::ggplot(ggplot2::aes(x = res_rank, y = perc_id)) +
  ggplot2::geom_violin(trim = FALSE) +
  ggplot2::geom_boxplot(width = 0.2, outlier.size = 0.3) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "Best BLAST consensus rank", y = "Top hit percent identity")

figA1 + figA2
```

# 📊 Supl Plot : details blast results 2

```{r}

blast2tax <- readr::read_tsv(data_path("raw_data/7_ANML.tax.tsv")) |> 
  rename(zotu_id = query) |> 
   dplyr::mutate(
    zotu_id = stringr::str_to_lower(zotu_id)
  ) |> 
  dplyr::mutate(
    dplyr::across(
      .cols = c("species","genus","family", "order"),
      .fns = ~ dplyr::na_if(., "Nan")
    )
  )

#need to make sure only species from oahu data set are included
# need to merge with taxonomy_oahu

blast2tax <- blast2tax |>
  dplyr::inner_join(
    taxonomy_oahu |> dplyr::select(zotu_id))


name_chaos <- blast2tax |>
  dplyr::group_by(zotu_id) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_species_names = dplyr::n_distinct(species[!is.na(species) & species != ""]),
    mean_perc_id = mean(perc_id, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

figB1 <- name_chaos |>
  ggplot2::ggplot(ggplot2::aes(x = n_species_names)) +
  ggplot2::geom_histogram(binwidth = 1, boundary = 0.5, closed = "right") +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "Number of distinct species names among BLAST hits",
                y = "Number of zOTUs") |> 
  #x axis from 1 to 10 showing each value
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:10, limits = c(0.5, 10.5))

figB2 <- name_chaos |>
  ggplot2::ggplot(ggplot2::aes(x = mean_perc_id, y = n_species_names)) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(alpha = 0.3) +
  ggplot2::geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = TRUE) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "Mean BLAST percent identity",
                y = "Number of distinct species names") |> 
  #y axis from 1 to 10 showing each value
  ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(breaks = 1:10, limits = c(0.5, 10.5))


figB1 + figB2
```

# 📊 Bar plots colored

```{r}
# color scheme that should indicate usefullness for studies
# species == a nice green,
# genus == a lighter green,
# family == orange
# higher_or_none == should be alarming but not red because of colorbblindness

color_palette <- c(
  "species"        = "#2ca02c",
  "genus"          = "#98df8a",
  "family"         = "#ff7f0e",
  "order or higher" = "brown"
)

figC_NCBI <- taxonomy_oahu |>
  drop_na(order) |> 
  dplyr::count(order, res_rank) |>
  dplyr::group_by(order) |>
  dplyr::mutate(prop = n / sum(n)) |>
  dplyr::ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    res_rank = factor(res_rank,
      levels = c("species", "genus", "family", "order or higher")
    ),
    order = forcats::fct_rev(forcats::fct_infreq(order))

  ggplot(aes(x = order, y = prop, fill = res_rank)) +
```

# 📉 table comparison
```{r}

# Load invasive status predictions from NIClassify + BLAST mapping
status <- read.csv(here::here("NIClassify/06_NIClassify_predict.csv")) |> 
  janitor::clean_names() |> 
  dplyr::rename(zotu_id = upid) |> 
  filter(str_detect(zotu_id, "Zotu")) |> 
  select(zotu_id, status_final = final_status, status_ni = predict)

# Load BLAST/IBIS predictions from Excel (manual curation)
status_blast <- read.xlsx(file.path(legacy_output, "tax_invasive.xlsx"), sheet = "taxonomy")  |> 
  janitor::clean_names() |> 
  select(zotu_id, status_genus) |> 
  rename(status_blast = status_genus)

#Load BOLD predictions from Excel (manual curation)
status_bold <- read.xlsx(file.path(legacy_output, "tax_invasive.xlsx"), sheet = "taxonomy_bold") |> 
  mutate(
    zotu_id = stringr::str_to_lower(id),.before = "id"
  ) |> 
  select(zotu_id, status_bold = status_genus) |> 
  #unknown needs to be NA in stauts_bold
  mutate(
    status_bold = ifelse(status_bold == "unknown", NA_character_, status_bold)
  )
  

# Combine and clean all invasion status sources
status_comb <- status |> 
  left_join(status_blast, by = "zotu_id") |> 
  dplyr::rename(ibis_status = status_final) |> 
  # Convert blank strings to NA
  mutate(across(c(ibis_status, status_ni, status_blast), 
                ~ ifelse(.x == "", NA_character_, .x))) |> 
    mutate(
    zotu_id = stringr::str_to_lower(zotu_id)
  ) |> 
  left_join(status_bold, by = "zotu_id") |> 
  # Normalize case and rename columns for clarity
  mutate(
    Ibis      = tolower(ibis_status), 
    NiClassify= tolower(status_ni), 
    BOLD      = tolower(status_bold),
    NCBI     = tolower(status_blast),
    zotu_id   = tolower(zotu_id)
    
  ) |> 
  select(-contains("status"))  # drop original status columns

summary_stats <- status_comb |> 
  #calculate % introduces vs native vs NA for each method 
  #first pivot longer
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Ibis, NiClassify, NCBI, BOLD), 
               names_to = "method", values_to = "status") |>
  group_by(method, status) |>
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop") |> 
  #pivot wider for nicer table
  pivot_wider(names_from = status, values_from = count, values_fill = 0) |> 
  dplyr::rename("No information available" = "NA")


# Use gt to export a publication-ready summary table
summary_stats |> 
  gt() |> 
  tab_header(title = "Summary of Invasive Status Predictions") |> 
  cols_label(method = "Prediction Method") |> 
  fmt_number(columns = everything(), decimals = 0) |> 
  cols_width(everything() ~ px(150)) |> 
  tab_spanner(
    label = "Invasive Status", 
    columns = c("introduced", "native", "No information available")
  ) |> 
  tab_source_note(
    source_note = "Data obtained through Ibis geolocation API, BLAST mapping paired species lookup &  NIClassify predictions"
  ) 

#save the table as a png file using gtsave recursive with date in the name starting with date_T1_title

gtsave(
   summary_stats |> 
    gt() |> 
    tab_header(title = "Summary of Invasive Status Predictions") |> 
    cols_label(method = "Prediction Method") |> 
    fmt_number(columns = everything(), decimals = 0) |> 
    cols_width(everything() ~ px(150)) |> 
    tab_spanner(
      label = "Invasive Status", 
      columns = c("introduced", "native", "No information available")
    ) |> 
    tab_source_note(
      source_note = "Data obtained through Ibis geolocation API, BLAST mapping paired species lookup &  NIClassify predictions"
    ), 
  filename = here::here("papers","niclassify_paper","outputs","fig_main",
                         paste0(Sys.Date(),"_","T1_invasive_status_summary_table", ".png"))
)


gtsave(summary_stats |> 
  gt() |> 
  tab_header(title = "Summary of Invasive Status Predictions") |> 
  cols_label(method = "Prediction Method") |> 
  fmt_number(columns = everything(), decimals = 0) |> 
  cols_width(everything() ~ px(150)) |> 
  tab_spanner(
    label = "Invasive Status", 
    columns = c("introduced", "native", "No information available")
  ) |> 
  tab_source_note(
    source_note = "Data obtained through Ibis geolocation API, BLAST mapping paired species lookup &  NIClassify predictions"
  ), filename = here::here("papers","niclassify_paper","outputs","tables", "invasive_status_summary.png"))
```

# Summarized classiier
```{r}
comparison_summary <- taxonomy_comparison_oahu |> 
   select(zotu_id, order, family, genus, species, selected_level) |> 
   group_by(zotu_id) |> 
  #mutate and give the whole columns a prefix to make sure we can distinguish between NCBI and BOLD results in the final summary table
  rename_with(~ paste0("NCBI_", .x), -zotu_id) 

  

BOLD_summary <- taxonomy_bold |> 
  select(zotu_id, order, family, genus, species, selected_level) |>
  group_by(zotu_id) |> 
  #mutate and give the whole columns a prefix to make sure we can distinguish between NCBI and BOLD results in the final summary table
  rename_with(~ paste0("BOLD_", .x), -zotu_id)

# Join the two summaries to compare NCBI and BOLD results and check if they are the same, or different, also need to added if NCBI or BOLD has missing information for the same zotu_id


# Step A. Define an expanded rank map
level_rank <- c(
  higher = 0L,   # catch-all for anything above order if you use it
  phylum = 0L,
  class  = 0L,
  order  = 1L,
  family = 2L,
  genus  = 3L,
  species = 4L
)

rank_or_zero <- function(x) {
  if (is.na(x) || !(x %in% names(level_rank))) 0L else unname(level_rank[[x]])
}
#This keeps your “4 ranks” as the meaningful part (1–4) while allowing coarser calls to be “not missing”.

#Step B. Compare only the 4 rank columns, but handle coarser levels correctly
tax_ranks <- c("order","family","genus","species")

total_summary <- comparison_summary |>
  left_join(BOLD_summary, by = "zotu_id") |>
  mutate(
    across(c(all_of(paste0("NCBI_", tax_ranks)),
             all_of(paste0("BOLD_", tax_ranks))),
           ~ str_trim(.) |> na_if("") |> na_if("Nan") |> str_replace_all("\\s+"," "))
  ) |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(
    ncbi_r = rank_or_zero(NCBI_selected_level),
    bold_r = rank_or_zero(BOLD_selected_level),

    # missing = truly no level at all (NA), not "phylum/class/higher"
    ncbi_missing = is.na(NCBI_selected_level),
    bold_missing = is.na(BOLD_selected_level),

    # if both are at least order-or-better, we can compare at shared rank depth
    shared_r = min(ncbi_r, bold_r),

    conflict_at = {
      ranks_to_check <- tax_ranks[c(1L,2L,3L,4L) <= shared_r]  # only ranks <= shared depth
      first_conflict <- NA_character_
      for (rk in ranks_to_check) {
        n <- get(paste0("NCBI_", rk))
        b <- get(paste0("BOLD_", rk))
        if (!is.na(n) && !is.na(b) && n != b) { first_conflict <- rk; break }
      }
      first_conflict
    },

    same_lineage_shared = is.na(conflict_at),
    exact_match = same_lineage_shared && (ncbi_r == bold_r)
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    comparison_result = case_when(
      ncbi_missing & bold_missing ~ "Both missing",
      ncbi_missing & !bold_missing ~ "NCBI missing",
      !ncbi_missing & bold_missing ~ "BOLD missing",

      # both exist but at least one is above-order (rank 0): cannot compare lineage using your 4 columns
      (ncbi_r == 0L | bold_r == 0L) ~ "Coarser than order (not comparable)",

      !is.na(conflict_at) ~ paste0("Conflict at ", conflict_at),
      exact_match ~ "Exact match",
      same_lineage_shared & (ncbi_r != bold_r) ~ "Same lineage (Order and lower)\n different resolution",
      TRUE ~ "Unclear"
    ),
    better_classifier = case_when(
      comparison_result == "Both missing" ~ "Both missing",
      comparison_result == "NCBI missing" ~ "BOLD better",
      comparison_result == "BOLD missing" ~ "NCBI better",
      comparison_result == "Exact match" ~ "Both same",

      comparison_result == "Same lineage (Order and lower)\n different resolution" ~ case_when(
        ncbi_r > bold_r ~ "NCBI better",
        bold_r > ncbi_r ~ "BOLD better",
        TRUE ~ "Both same"
      ),

      comparison_result == "Coarser than order (not comparable)" ~ case_when(
        ncbi_r > bold_r ~ "NCBI better",
        bold_r > ncbi_r ~ "BOLD better",
        TRUE ~ "Both coarse"
      ),

      str_detect(comparison_result, "^Conflict at") ~ "Conflict",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )


#figure that shows general match missmatch between ncbi and bold
#keep which classifier is better so we can color it 
fig1_df <- total_summary |>
  mutate(
    comparison_result = fct_relevel(
      factor(comparison_result),
      "Exact match",
      "Conflict at species",
      "Conflict at genus",
      "Conflict at family",
      "Conflict at order",
      "Same lineage (Order and lower)\n different resolution",
      "Coarser than order (not comparable)",
      "NCBI missing",
      "BOLD missing",
      "Both missing",
      "Unclear"
    ),
    comparison_result = fct_drop(comparison_result),
    better_classifier = fct_drop(factor(better_classifier))
  ) |>
  count(comparison_result, better_classifier, name = "n") |>
  group_by(comparison_result) |>
  mutate(
    prop_within_result = n / sum(n)   # % of classifiers inside this category
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    prop_overall = n / sum(n)         # % of total dataset
  )

fig1_df <- fig1_df |>
  mutate(
    better_classifier = case_when(
      is.na(better_classifier) ~ "Tie",
      str_detect(str_to_lower(better_classifier), "ncbi") ~ "NCBI",
      str_detect(str_to_lower(better_classifier), "bold") ~ "BOLD",
      str_detect(str_to_lower(better_classifier), "tie|equal|same|both") ~ "Tie",
      TRUE ~ "Tie"
    ),
    better_classifier = factor(better_classifier, levels = c("NCBI","BOLD","Tie"))
  )


p1 <- ggplot(fig1_df, aes(x = comparison_result, y = prop_overall, fill = better_classifier)) +
  geom_col(color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("NCBI" = "#20558a", "BOLD" = "orange", "Tie" = "grey30"),
    name = "better classifier"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Proportion of ZOTUs",
    title = ""
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

p1

```

```{r}

fig2_df <- total_summary |>
  filter(
    !comparison_result %in% c("Both missing", "NCBI missing", "BOLD missing"),
    comparison_result != "Coarser than order (not comparable)"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    # make labels publication-safe: "better" -> "higher resolution"
    resolution_winner = case_when(
      better_classifier == "NCBI better" ~ "NCBI higher resolution",
      better_classifier == "BOLD better" ~ "BOLD higher resolution",
      better_classifier == "Both same" ~ "Same resolution",
      TRUE ~ "Conflict"
    ),
    resolution_winner = fct_relevel(
      factor(resolution_winner),
      "NCBI higher resolution",
      "BOLD higher resolution",
      "Same resolution",
      "Conflict"
    )
  ) |>
  count(resolution_winner, name = "n") |>
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n))

p2 <- ggplot(fig2_df, aes(x = resolution_winner, y = prop)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Proportion of comparable ZOTUs",
    title = "Which database yields higher taxonomic resolution?"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 20, hjust = 1),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )


p2 + p1
```

# 📊 Figure 2 Sankey

## 📊 Sankey Ecology based on BLAST PANEL (A)

```{r}
# Load invasive status predictions from NIClassify + BLAST mapping
status <- read.csv(here::here("NIClassify/06_NIClassify_predict.csv")) |> 
  janitor::clean_names() |> 
  dplyr::rename(zotu_id = upid) |> 
  filter(str_detect(zotu_id, "Zotu")) |> 
  select(zotu_id, status_final = final_status, status_ni = predict)

# Load BLAST/IBIS predictions from Excel (manual curation)
status_blast <- read.xlsx(file.path(legacy_output, "tax_invasive.xlsx"), sheet = "taxonomy") |> 
  janitor::clean_names() |> 
  select(zotu_id, status_genus)



# Combine and clean all invasion status sources
status <- status |> 
  left_join(status_blast, by = "zotu_id") |> 
  dplyr::rename(ibis_status = status_final) |> 
  # Convert blank strings to NA
  mutate(across(c(ibis_status, status_ni, status_genus), 
                ~ ifelse(.x == "", NA_character_, .x))) |> 
  # Normalize case and rename columns for clarity
  mutate(
    Ibis      = tolower(ibis_status), 
    NiClassify= tolower(status_ni), 
    Blast     = tolower(status_genus),
    zotu_id   = tolower(zotu_id)
  ) |> 
  select(-contains("status"))  # drop original status columns

# DONT DELETE NEEDED
guild_from_order_ok <- c(
  "Araneae",          # predators
  "Isopoda",          # detritivores
  "Trombidiformes",   # detritivores / microbivores
  "Sarcoptiformes",   # detritivores / microbivores
  "Mesostigmata",     # parasites / predators
  "Psocoptera",       # plant-associated (sap/lichen)
  "Diplopoda",        # detritivors
  "Chilopoda",         # predators
  "Entomobryomorpha"  # detrivors
)


sankey_taxonomy_df <- b_taxonomy_df |>
    mutate(
    guild_possible = order %in% guild_from_order_ok
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    # nicer labels for BLAST resolution
    res_rank = recode(
      res_rank,
      "species"        = "Species-level",
      "genus"          = "Genus-level",
      "family"         = "Family-level",
      "higher_or_none" = "Order-or-higher"
    ),
    res_rank = factor(
      res_rank,
      levels = c("Species-level", "Genus-level",
                 "Family-level", "Order-or-higher")
    ),

    # "real" name, not just "Genus sp."
    fine_name = !is.na(species) & !grepl(" sp\\.?$", species),

    eco_scope_blast = case_when(
      res_rank %in% c("Species-level", "Genus-level") & fine_name ~
        "Fine-scale (species/genus)",
      guild_possible ~ "Coarse guild only",   # from our previous step
      TRUE           ~ "No ecological inference"
    ),
    eco_scope_blast = factor(
      eco_scope_blast,
      levels = c("Fine-scale (species/genus)",
                 "Coarse guild only",
                 "No ecological inference")
    )
  )
```

```{r}

# 1. Flow table ---------------------------------------------------------

flows_eco <- sankey_taxonomy_df |>
  filter(!is.na(res_rank), !is.na(eco_scope_blast)) |>
  dplyr::count(res_rank, eco_scope_blast, name = "value")

# 2. Nodes with explicit group labels ----------------------------------

nodes_ecology <- tibble(
  name = factor(c(
    "Species-level",
    "Genus-level",
    "Family-level",
    "Order-or-higher",
    "Fine-scale (species/genus)",
    "Coarse guild only",
    "No ecological inference"
  ), levels = c(
    "Species-level",
    "Genus-level",
    "Family-level",
    "Order-or-higher",
    "Fine-scale (species/genus)",
    "Coarse guild only",
    "No ecological inference"
  )) 
) |> 
  mutate(
    group = case_when(
      name == "Species-level"              ~ "rank_species",
      name == "Genus-level"                ~ "rank_genus",
      name == "Family-level"               ~ "rank_family",
      name == "Order-or-higher"            ~ "rank_higher",
      name == "Fine-scale (species/genus)" ~ "eco_fine",
      name == "Coarse guild only"          ~ "eco_guild",
      name == "No ecological inference"    ~ "eco_none",
      TRUE                                 ~ "other"
    )
)

    

# 3. Links grouped by eco use case -------------------------------------

links_ecology <- flows_eco |>
  mutate(
    source = match(as.character(res_rank), as.character(nodes$name)) - 1,
    target = match(as.character(eco_scope_blast), as.character(nodes$name)) - 1,
    group  = case_when(
      eco_scope_blast == "Fine-scale (species/genus)" ~ "eco_fine",
      eco_scope_blast == "Coarse guild only"          ~ "eco_guild",
      eco_scope_blast == "No ecological inference"    ~ "eco_none"
    )
  ) |>
  select(source, target, value, group)

# sanity check:
unique(nodes_ecology$group)

# 4. Colour scale: shared colors for matching rank/eco pairs ----------

colourJS <- networkD3::JS("
  d3.scaleOrdinal()
    .domain([
      'rank_species',
      'rank_genus',
      'rank_family',
      'rank_higher',
      'eco_fine',
      'eco_guild',
      'eco_none'
    ])
    .range([
      '#2ca02c',  // rank_species (species)
      '#98df8a',  // rank_genus   (genus)
      '#ff7f0e',  // rank_family  (family)
      'brown',    // rank_higher  (higher_or_none)
      '#98df8a',  // eco_fine     (Fine-scale)
      '#ff7f0e',  // eco_guild    (Coarse guild)
      'brown'     // eco_none     (No ecology)
    ])
")

# 5. Sankey ------------------------------------------------------------

sankey_eco <- sankeyNetwork(
  Links       = links_ecology,
  Nodes       = nodes_ecology,
  Source      = "source",
  Target      = "target",
  Value       = "value",
  NodeID      = "name",
  NodeGroup   = "group",
  LinkGroup   = "group",
  colourScale = colourJS,
  fontSize    = 24,
  nodeWidth   = 34,
  sinksRight  = TRUE,
  iterations  = 0
)


sankey_eco





# 1) Save the widget as an HTML file
eco_html <- here("figures", "sankey_eco.html")
htmlwidgets::saveWidget(
  widget = sankey_eco,
  file   = eco_html,
  selfcontained = TRUE
)

# 2) Take a PNG snapshot of that HTML

library(webshot2)
png_file <- here("figures", "sankey_eco.png")

webshot2::webshot(
  url    = eco_html,
  file   = png_file,
  vwidth = 1200,   # tweak size as needed
  vheight = 700,
  zoom   = 2       # higher zoom = higher resolution
)
```

## 📊 Sankey trust based on BLAST (PANEL B)

```{r}
# Load manual BLAST trust assignments
status_blast <- read.xlsx(file.path(legacy_output, "tax_invasive.xlsx"), sheet = "taxonomy") |> 
  janitor::clean_names() |> 
  select(zotu_id, trust) |> 
  mutate(trust = case_when(
    trust == "yes" ~ "trustworthy",
    trust == "no"  ~ "not usable",
    TRUE           ~ NA_character_
  )) |> 
  mutate(zotu_id = tolower(zotu_id))

# Merge into taxonomy table
taxonomy_trust <- sankey_taxonomy_df |> 
  left_join(status_blast, by = "zotu_id") |>
  filter(!is.na(res_rank), !is.na(trust))  # exclude missing data

# Count flow values
flows_trust <- taxonomy_trust |>
  dplyr::count(res_rank, trust, name = "value")

# Define nodes for Sankey
nodes_trust <- tibble(
  name = c(
    "Species-level",
    "Genus-level",
    "Family-level",
    "Order-or-higher",
    "Trustworthy ecological info",
    "Not usable or misleading"
  ),
  group = c(
    "rank_species", "rank_genus", "rank_family", "rank_higher",
    "trust_yes", "trust_no"
  )
)

# Build links (match source and target to node index)
links_trust <- flows_trust |> 
  mutate(
    source = match(res_rank, nodes_trust$name) - 1,
    target = match(
      case_when(
        trust == "trustworthy" ~ "Trustworthy ecological info",
        trust == "not usable"  ~ "Not usable or misleading"
      ),
      nodes_trust$name
    ) - 1,
    group = ifelse(trust == "trustworthy", "trust_yes", "trust_no")
  ) |> 
  select(source, target, value, group)

# Define color palette (green for trusted, grey for omitted)
colourJS_trust <- networkD3::JS("
  d3.scaleOrdinal()
    .domain([
      'rank_species',
      'rank_genus',
      'rank_family',
      'rank_higher',
      'trust_yes',
      'trust_no'
    ])
    .range([
      '#2ca02c',  // species
      '#98df8a',  // genus
      '#ff7f0e',  // family
      'brown',    // order or higher
      '#2ca02c',  // trustworthy
      '#bdbdbd'   // not usable
    ])
")

# Create Sankey plot
sankey_trust <- sankeyNetwork(
  Links       = links_trust,
  Nodes       = nodes_trust,
  Source      = "source",
  Target      = "target",
  Value       = "value",
  NodeID      = "name",
  NodeGroup   = "group",
  LinkGroup   = "group",
  colourScale = colourJS_trust,
  fontSize    = 24,
  nodeWidth   = 34,
  sinksRight  = TRUE,
  iterations  = 0
  )

# Show the plot
sankey_trust

# Save HTML + PNG
trust_html <- here("figures", "sankey_trust.html")
htmlwidgets::saveWidget(sankey_trust, trust_html, selfcontained = TRUE)

webshot2::webshot(
  url    = trust_html,
  file   = here("figures", "sankey_trust.png"),
  vwidth = 1200,
  vheight = 700,
  zoom   = 2
)

```

## 📊 Sankey native non native BLAST (PANEL C)

```{r}

# Load status table from BLAST
status_blast <- read.xlsx(file.path(legacy_output, "tax_invasive.xlsx"), sheet = "taxonomy") |>
  janitor::clean_names() |>
  select(zotu_id, status_genus) |> 
  mutate(status_blast = case_when(
    status_genus %in% c("native", "Native") ~ "Native",
    status_genus %in% c("introduced", "Introduced") ~ "Introduced",
    TRUE ~ "No information"
  )) |> 
  select(zotu_id, status_blast) |> 
  mutate(zotu_id = tolower(zotu_id))

# Merge into taxonomy table

  filter(!is.na(res_rank), !is.na(status_blast)) |>
  mutate(
    res_rank = recode(
      res_rank,
      "species" = "Species-level",
      "genus"   = "Genus-level",
      "family"  = "Family-level",
      "higher_or_none" = "Order-or-higher"
    ),
    res_rank = factor(res_rank, levels = c("Species-level", "Genus-level", "Family-level", "Order-or-higher")),
    status_blast = factor(status_blast, levels = c("Native", "Introduced", "No information"))
  )

    "Genus-level",
    "Family-level",
    "Order-or-higher",
    "Native",
    "Introduced",
    "No information"
  ),
  group = c(
    "rank_species", "rank_genus", "rank_family", "rank_higher",
    "status_native", "status_introduced", "status_unknown"
  )
)

  mutate(
    source = match(res_rank, nodes_blast$name) - 1,

")
```

## 📊 Sankey native non native NiClassify (Panel D)

```{r}

# Make sure status is loaded and cleaned
status <- read.csv(here::here("NIClassify/06_NIClassify_predict.csv")) |> 
  janitor::clean_names() |> 
  dplyr::rename(zotu_id = upid) |> 
  filter(str_detect(zotu_id, "Zotu")) |> 
  dplyr::select(zotu_id, status_ni = predict) |> 
  mutate(zotu_id = tolower(zotu_id))

# Merge with taxonomy
taxonomy_ni <- sankey_taxonomy_df |>
  left_join(status, by = "zotu_id") |> 
  mutate(
    status_ni = case_when(
      status_ni %in% c("native", "Native")         ~ "native",
      status_ni %in% c("introduced", "Introduced") ~ "introduced",
      TRUE                                         ~ "uncertain"
    ),
    res_rank = factor(res_rank, levels = c("Species-level", "Genus-level", "Family-level", "Order-or-higher")),
    status_ni = factor(status_ni, levels = c("native", "introduced"))
  )

# Flow table: res_rank on left, status_ni on right
flows_ni <- taxonomy_ni |>
  filter(!is.na(res_rank), !is.na(status_ni)) |>
  dplyr::count(res_rank, status_ni, name = "value")

# Nodes
nodes_ni <- tibble(
  name = factor(c(
    "Species-level",
    "Genus-level",
    "Family-level",
    "Order-or-higher",
    "Native",
    "Introduced"
  ), levels = c(
    "Species-level",
    "Genus-level",
    "Family-level",
    "Order-or-higher",
    "Native",
    "Introduced"
  ))
) |>
  mutate(
    group = case_when(
      name == "Species-level"   ~ "rank_species",
      name == "Genus-level"     ~ "rank_genus",
      name == "Family-level"    ~ "rank_family",
      name == "Order-or-higher" ~ "rank_higher",
      name == "Native"          ~ "ni_native",
      name == "Introduced"      ~ "ni_intro"
    )
  )

# Links
links_ni <- flows_ni |>
  mutate(
    source = match(res_rank, nodes_ni$name) - 1,
    target = match(case_when(
      status_ni == "native"     ~ "Native",
      status_ni == "introduced" ~ "Introduced"
    ), nodes_ni$name) - 1,
    group = case_when(
      status_ni == "native"     ~ "ni_native",
      status_ni == "introduced" ~ "ni_intro"
    )
  ) |>
  select(source, target, value, group)

# Color scale update
colourJS_ni <- networkD3::JS("
  d3.scaleOrdinal()
    .domain([
      'rank_species',
      'rank_genus',
      'rank_family',
      'rank_higher',
      'ni_native',
      'ni_intro'
    ])
    .range([
      '#2ca02c',  // species
      '#98df8a',  // genus
      '#ff7f0e',  // family
      'brown',    // order+
      '#1f78b4',  // native
      '#e31a1c'   // introduced
    ])
")

# Create Sankey
sankey_ni <- sankeyNetwork(
  Links       = links_ni,
  Nodes       = nodes_ni,
  Source      = "source",
  Target      = "target",
  Value       = "value",
  NodeID      = "name",
  NodeGroup   = "group",
  LinkGroup   = "group",
  colourScale = colourJS_ni,
  fontSize    = 24,
  nodeWidth   = 34,

  iterations  = 0
)
```
